title: Food-contact material evidence checklist
text: For a food storage product, keep supplier material declarations, identify the material used for each food-contact component, and verify any product-specific labeling and market requirements before sale.

title: Marketing-claim evidence checklist
text: Do not present performance or safety claims as established facts unless the seller retains evidence supporting the exact claim. Record the claim wording, the supporting material, and the market where it will be used.

title: Electrical accessory verification checklist
text: For products used near power strips or chargers, identify whether the item itself has electrical functions. Preserve product specifications and evaluate heat, access, and intended-use risks before making suitability claims.
